verdict.rationale: Adyen documents public, programmatic APIs for Agentic Commerce. These include the Agentic Cart API (session create, commit and cancel), the Agentic Feed API (batch product uploads synced to AI platforms), and ACP/UCP token and checkout-session flows for agent platforms. Adyen also publishes OpenAPI definitions on GitHub; the probe 404s on the docs domain do not contradict this, because the specs are published there. Missing for 10: OpenAPI specs tied explicitly to the agentic-commerce endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving these APIs end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
